messages:
morgan: quick flag
noticed tiny tenants seeing transient invoice lines after priority-router flip. looks like meter emits before enrichment finishes.
lee: can you paste a trace?
morgan: minimal snippet (ids redacted):
```
2026-04-22T13:05:12.100Z INFO req=RN12 router=priority-fast decision=optimistic
2026-04-22T13:05:12.101Z DEBUG enrich=start req=RN12
2026-04-22T13:05:12.103Z INFO meter=emit tenant=null tokens=29 req=RN12
2026-04-22T13:05:12.106Z INFO enrich=done tenant=org-mini req=RN12
```
harper: yep that's the race. blocking hurts p50 for fast lane. propose: provisional emits + attribution_key, then reconciler emits correction events.
sam: agree. billing-event schema: add attribution_key, provisional(true|false), original_route, event_seq. reconciler sends final=true corrections. preview must fold corrections atomically.
morgan: UI: show "Draft" badge on provisional lines and keep them out of default CSV. metrics: provisional_emits_total, provisional_reconciled_total, draft_doublecount_rate. alert if draft_doublecount_rate > 0.2% per tenant-day.
lee: rollout: feature-flag at router, shadow 1% for 48h, then 5% for 72h if diffs <0.05%. rollback if tenant diff >0.1% or >2 support tickets/day. creating ticket INF-9999.
harper: i'll own reconciler changes, sam can own schema + meter. morgan will draft support KB and UI copy.
devops-bot: ALERT: invoice-preview-anomaly detected 3 tenants in eu-west at 13:06 UTC.
morgan: thanks all, keep canary tiny and watch the draft metrics closely :thumbsup:
